# Auto-generated by VerityQA Autonomous Investigation Agent
# Replayable Application Journey Test
import pytest
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, expect

def test_primary_discovered_progression():
    """
    Test Objective: Replay and verify the discovered application journey "Primary Discovered Progression".
    Preconditions: Application server is online and reachable.
    Evidence Grounding: Derived directly from empirical DOM observations and state transitions.
    """
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = browser.new_context()
        page = context.new_page()

        # Step 1: Navigate to entry view: https://www.saucedemo.com/
        page.goto('https://www.saucedemo.com/', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        # Step 2: Populate authorized username
        page.locator('#user-name').fill('standard_user')
        # Step 3: Populate authorized password
        page.locator('#password').fill(__import__('os').environ['VERITYQA_TEST_PASSWORD'])
        # Step 4: Submit login authentication
        page.locator('#login-button').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        # Step 5: Trigger #add-to-cart-sauce-labs-backpack [Evidence: ev-9a44f5c6]
        page.locator('#add-to-cart-sauce-labs-backpack').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        assert 'Products' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Products'
        assert page.locator('#react-burger-menu-btn').count() > 0
        # Step 6: Select option 'za' on [data-test="product-sort-container"] [Evidence: ev-4b2eba64]
        page.locator('[data-test="product-sort-container"]').select_option('za')
        assert 'Products' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Products'
        assert page.locator('#react-burger-menu-btn').count() > 0
        # Step 7: Trigger [data-test="shopping-cart-link"] [Evidence: ev-93d2b496]
        page.locator('[data-test="shopping-cart-link"]').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        assert '/cart.html' in page.url, f'Expected /cart.html in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert 'Your Cart' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Your Cart'
        assert page.locator('#react-burger-menu-btn').count() > 0
        # Step 8: Trigger #checkout [Evidence: ev-feed4aba]
        page.locator('#checkout').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        assert '/checkout-step-one.html' in page.url, f'Expected /checkout-step-one.html in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert 'Checkout: Your Information' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Checkout: Your Information'
        assert page.locator('#react-burger-menu-btn').count() > 0
        # Step 9: Trigger #item_4_title_link [Evidence: ev-1203d03a]
        page.locator('#item_4_title_link').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        assert '/inventory-item.html' in page.url, f'Expected /inventory-item.html in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert page.locator('#react-burger-menu-btn').count() > 0
        # Step 10: Trigger #remove-sauce-labs-backpack [Evidence: ev-44a1cce5]
        page.locator('#remove-sauce-labs-backpack').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        assert 'Your Cart' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Your Cart'
        assert page.locator('#react-burger-menu-btn').count() > 0
        # Step 11: Trigger #item_3_title_link [Evidence: ev-9ac51467]
        page.locator('#item_3_title_link').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        assert '/inventory-item.html' in page.url, f'Expected /inventory-item.html in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert page.locator('#react-burger-menu-btn').count() > 0

        # Verify final application state and DOM integrity
        assert page.url is not None and page.url.startswith('http')
        assert len(page.locator('body').inner_text().strip()) > 0
        browser.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_primary_discovered_progression()
    print('Journey replay completed successfully.')
